title: Error type design is clean and consistent
description: src/error.rs:1-96. AppError is a simple status+message struct with named constructors (bad_request, not_found, etc.) that maps cleanly to JSON error bodies via IntoResponse. The From<sqlx::Error> and From<anyhow::Error> impls log the real error but return a generic 'Internal server error' to the client — correct information hygiene. Every handler returns Result<_, AppError>. No unwrap() in request-reachable paths. This is a well-designed error boundary.
